rule: Background 8 contains one edge-to-edge straight line of colour 1 (vertical, horizontal, diagonal r-c=k or anti-diagonal r+c=s). Count the total cells of each object colour. Reflect every object of the colour with the strictly smaller total across the line. Paint a mirrored cell only where it lands inside the grid on background. Everything else is unchanged.
scope: Reflect all cells of the colour with the smallest total cell count across a full straight mirror line. Sample four orientations, separated polyominoes and explicit anti-shortcut count controls.
constraints: All four canonical pairs reconstruct exactly; 1,000 independent archived-solver checks give 1,000 distinct inputs.

authored_scope:
Supported in random mode:
- All four orientations; offset diagonals on rectangular grids up to 30x30.
- 2-6 separated polyominoes (each 2+ cells, within a 4x4 box) on one side of the line.
- Diagonal-line objects may touch the line at a corner (offset 2), as in the canonical test.
- Typed controls: height, width, kind, line, side, colors, and the anti-proxy flags hard, tight and smallbreak.

Feasibility is exact:
- Orthogonal minimum line length is 2, 3, 4 or 6 for depth >=4, 3, 2 or 1.
- Diagonal segments need at least 6 cells.
- Under default flags, a constructive domino plus tromino fallback means every accepted geometry produces a scene.

Explicit objects= mode is a documented extension. It reproduces the fixtures and supports clipped or occluded mirrors, objects on both sides, and more than two colours.

Not sampled by default: clipped or occluded mirrors, objects on both sides, single-cell objects, more than two object colours.
authored_constraints: Exactly one 1-line of length >= 2, so its orientation is unambiguous
Random objects lie on one side, with |offset| >= 2 from the line, so they never share an edge with it
Every random mirror cell lies in the grid on background, so the output adds exactly the rare total
Objects never touch each other, even diagonally
The two colour totals differ, so the rarest colour is unique
Object colours are distinct from 1 and 8
Background 8 is strictly the most frequent colour
Geometries are sampled only when they are feasible for the domino + tromino witness
